response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.arcref AS arcref, p.fundflux AS fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT g.arcref, g.fundflux, g.rate, g.rate - b.bench AS excess FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bench ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
